messages:
alex_ops: Heads-up: VendorCore H100 shipment flagged at FRA customs for mismatched serial ranges vs invoice. Depot put pallet on legal hold. ETA now uncertain until docs fixed.

mei_procure: Do we have the AWB and manifest? VendorCore says they transmitted corrected invoice but customs still shows a gap.

alex_ops: Uploaded evidence + manifest to s3: s3://redwood-procure/vendorcore/1766123456/payload.zip
```
AWB: 789-00011122
Manifest: H100-7001..H100-7040
Invoice: quantity: 36
Discrepancy: manifest lists 40 serials, invoice 36
```

jon_infra: If quarantine holds, eu-dedicated capacity drops ~14% next 72h. We should assemble a mitigation runway: loaner reassign + cross-region burst.

claire_product: We need a short customer message. Also flag any Reserved Capacity customers for proactive outreach.

mei_procure: VendorCore offered two options: (A) re-issue corrected invoice and customs release (ETA 6-12h) or (B) split-rebook 12 units on AirSwift (next-day) at surcharge of 150 with request that Redwood covers brokerage.

alex_ops: Quick calc: 12 units buys ~8% headroom. Can we live with that + shifting low-priority batch to us-central for 24-48h?

jon_infra: Yes. With 12 units we'd avoid SLA triggers for now if we throttle background training and enable multi-region routing. I can implement a temporary route policy.

mei_procure: Negotiation ask: push vendor for 50/50 on surcharge; push them to cover brokerage since paperwork error originated on their side. I'm willing to authorize up to 4k procurement float for expedite if finance ok.

zack_finance: Need legal/PO amendment to sign off on any >4k. Ping me with final vendor amendment.

mei_procure: Vendor core says they will accept 60/40 split (Redwood 40%) if we sign a delivery amendment. That'd be ~5k Redwood share.

alex_ops: Considering SLA risk, I'd approve the 40% if finance fast-tracks. We avoid larger downstream costs from customer credits.

claire_product: Draft customer bullets: 1) Minor EU region capacity reduction for up to 72h. 2) We've activated cross-region burst and reprioritized critical workloads. 3) No service data exposure. 4) We'll update in 12h. Keep neutral.

jon_infra: I'll snapshot Grafana queue and expected delta with +12 units. Posting in 10m. Current queued GPU-jobs +28% on eu pool.

docbot: VendorCore uploaded revised invoice v2 to s3: s3://vendorcore-invoices/1766123456/invoice_v2.pdf

mei_procure: I can sign the amendment if finance ok to pre-authorize up to 5k. Looping @zack_finance.

zack_finance: Pre-authorization OK up to 5k pending PO amendment and legal sign-off. Please attach LOA.

mei_procure: Signed amendment sent to vendor. Vendor confirms AirSwift AWB: 789-00011199 and ETA ~20h for 12 units. They'll reissue invoice for remaining 28 within 8h.

alex_ops: Great. Once AWB scans hit depot we will mark 12 units 'eu-edge-ready' after customs release. Jon, please prepare the route changes and a short rollback plan if scans don't arrive in 24h.

jon_infra: On it. Implementing multi-region routing policy: float up to 12 loaner units into eu-dedicated and shift non-critical jobs to us-central. Will monitor token latency.

claire_product: Customer note drafted. Holding until we confirm 12 units scanned. Will keep wording neutral and include mitigation steps.

docbot: Inventory note created: TEMP-HOLD-1766123456 on H100-7001..H100-7040. AirSwift AWB logged: 789-00011199.

mei_procure: Vendor confirms customs brokerage covered by them for the AirSwift rebook; Redwood share reduced to 5k. Closing negotiation.

alex_ops: Thanks. Once depot posts serial scans I'll send the customer update and release the hold for the 12 units.

jon_infra: Grafana snapshot: with +12 units queue reduction estimated -22% and latencies within SLA. Posting link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/edge/eu-capacity?panelId=4

claire_product: Sending customer bulletin now. Keep monitoring and update if vendor reissues remaining invoice.

alex_ops: Depot scanned AirSwift arrival: H100-7001..H100-7012 marked 'eu-edge-ready'. Marking hold clearance for those serials. Will follow up when vendor updates invoice for remaining units. :white_check_mark:
